elections.label: Redland City mayoral by-election
elections.status: Full postal by-election on 12 December 2026. Nominations run from 10 November until noon AEST on 19 November. Postal votes must be completed by 6pm AEST on 12 December and received by ECQ by 5pm AEST on 22 December.
elections.dateBasis: ECQ announced on 5 November 2026 that the by-election will be held on 12 December by full postal ballot. The countdown is to the start of that Brisbane calendar date, not the opening of polling or a postal deadline.
elections.milestoneLabel: start of mayoral by-election date (not a postal deadline)
elections.candidateCoverage: On 12 November, the ECQ register listed Melissa Millar and Gary Williamson, both Independent. Public intentions and party endorsements appear with their own labels. This is a snapshot during nominations; follow ECQ for later certifications and the final ballot.
elections.nominationDateBasis: ECQ’s issued notice and event timetable confirm nominations close at 12pm (noon) on 19 November 2026, Queensland local time (AEST, UTC+10). No opening clock time is stated.
